app.name: Simple POS
app.tagline: A simple till for small restaurants and shops

sell.emptyOrder: Tap an item to add it
sell.emptyMenuBody: Add the things you sell, then tap them here to start selling.

pay.title: Take payment
pay.notEnough: That is less than the total
pay.scan: Ask the customer to scan this code, then press the button below.
pay.promptpayMissing: Add your PromptPay number in My shop to show a payment code here.
pay.cardNote: Take the payment on your card machine, then press the button below.

saved.title: Saved bills
saved.emptyBody: Orders you keep for later wait here, for example a table that has not paid yet.

history.title: History
history.noneBody: Paid bills will show up here.

shop.title: My shop
shop.name: Shop name
shop.promptpayHint: Your mobile number or 13-digit ID. Customers can scan a code on screen.
shop.promptpayInvalid: Enter a 10-digit mobile number or a 13-digit ID
shop.vatExclusive: Add VAT on top of prices
shop.itemNameThHint: Shown when the app is in Thai
shop.importFail: That file needs a column for the item name and one for the price.

setup.welcomeTitle: Let us set up your shop
setup.welcomeBody: It takes about two minutes. You can change everything later.
setup.nameHint: This appears at the top and on your receipts.
setup.menuSampleBody: A few typical items you can change or delete.
setup.menuImportBody: A CSV file with item names and prices.
setup.payBody: Optional. You can do this later in My shop.

start.title: Open your own till
start.subtitle: One payment. Your sales, menu and receipts on any phone or tablet.
start.emailHint: For your account and your payment receipt
start.addOnBody: We adapt your menu, receipts and look to your shop.
start.secure: Payment is handled securely by Stripe.
start.cancelled: Payment was cancelled. You have not been charged.
start.errorInvalid: Please check your shop name and email.
start.errorUnavailable: Payment is not available right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
start.haveTill: Already have a till? Open it

welcome.workingBody: Your payment is confirmed. This takes a few seconds.
welcome.readyBody: Your sales and menu are saved to your account from now on.
welcome.slow: This is taking longer than usual. Your payment is safe. Reload this page in a minute.
welcome.claimedTitle: This till is already set up
welcome.claimedBody: Open it on the device where you started.
welcome.missingBody: Start from the beginning to open your till.
